description: Hydrogen Forecasts - East London Program - Shared is a dataset listed in Cadent Gas open data portal, an open data portal of a gas distribution network operator, published or maintained by Cadent Gas Ltd. Data Asset that contains Cadent's hydrogen demand forecast within East London Hydrogen programme. Forecasts are indicative only and provide a view of 5, 10 and 15 years ahead. This data asset is triaged as "Shared", and is only available on request. Please populate the contact form referencing the data asset name to request access. Coverage: Great Britain (network area of the operator or portal owner). The portal files it under Future Energy, Operational, Shared. Its keywords are Hydrogen, Demand, Forecast. The portal shows 2025-08-04 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Cadent Gas Data Sharing Agreement. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-cadent-open-data-portal.
